info.title: Yumio API
info.description:
REST API for the **Yumio** recipe application.

The API is mounted under the `/api` prefix. Authentication is session based: `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/refresh` set three `httpOnly` cookies (`sessionId`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`) that must be sent with every subsequent request.

- `sessionId` + `accessToken` authenticate requests to protected endpoints (`accessToken` lives for 15 minutes).
- `sessionId` + `refreshToken` are used by `POST /api/auth/refresh` to rotate the session (`refreshToken` lives for 24 hours).

Request payloads are validated with [celebrate](https://github.com/arb/celebrate) / Joi. A failed validation returns `400` with a `validation` object describing the offending segment (`body`, `query`, `params`) and the invalid keys.

post.description: Creates a user, hashes the password with bcrypt (10 rounds) and starts a session. On success the `sessionId`, `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies are set and the created user (without the password) is returned.

201.description: The user has been created and a session has been started.

400.description: The email is already registered, or the request body failed Joi validation.

body.message: Password must be at least 8 characters long

post.description: Looks the user up by email and compares the password with the stored bcrypt hash. The previous session of the user is deleted and a new one is created, so the cookies issued by the previous login stop working.

200.description: The user has been authenticated and a new session has been started.

post.description: Deletes the session referenced by the `sessionId` cookie and clears the `sessionId`, `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies. The endpoint does not fail when no session cookie is present.

204.description: The session has been terminated and the cookies cleared. No response body is returned.

post.description: Validates the `sessionId` + `refreshToken` cookie pair. If the refresh token is still valid the current session is rotated (deleted) and a new one is created with fresh `sessionId`, `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies. If the refresh token has expired the session is deleted and the cookies are cleared.

200.description: The session has been refreshed.

Set-Cookie.description: Replaces the `sessionId`, `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies with a new session.

post.description: Sends a password reset email if an account with the provided email exists. For security reasons the response is identical whether the user exists or not (anti user enumeration). The email contains a short-lived JWT reset token (15 minutes) that must be passed to `POST /api/auth/reset-password`.

200.description: The request has been processed. A reset email may be sent if the account exists.

example.message: If this email exists, a reset link has been sent

post.description: Verifies the reset token (JWT, 15 minutes) and sets a new password for the user. All existing sessions for that user are invalidated. The user must log in again after a successful reset.

200.description: The password has been reset successfully.

example.message: Password reset successfully. Please log in again.

401.description: The reset token is invalid or has expired.

get.description: Returns the profile of the user bound to the session cookies. The password is stripped from the response by the `toJSON` method of the user schema.

200.description: The profile of the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates the name of the authenticated user. The endpoint is not covered by a celebrate schema, so the body shape below is derived from the Mongoose user model and from the constraints applied to the same field during registration.

name.description: New display name. Trimmed by the Mongoose schema.

200.description: The updated profile of the authenticated user.

204.description: The user could not be found. The handler throws an `HttpError` with status `204`, therefore the response body is stripped by Express.

patch.description: Uploads a single image for the authenticated user, stores it in Cloudinary (folder `yumio-app/avatars`, 500x500 crop) and updates the `avatar` field of the user. The previous avatar is overwritten.

avatar.description: Image file. Allowed MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/jpg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`. Maximum size 2 MB.

200.description: The avatar has been uploaded and the new URL is returned.

get.description: Returns every category stored in the database. The same list is used to build the `category` enum of the recipe schemas.

200.description: The list of categories.

get.description: Returns every ingredient stored in the database. The `_id` of an ingredient is a human readable slug, not a MongoDB ObjectId, and is referenced by `ingredients[].id` of a recipe.

200.description: The list of ingredients.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of recipes. The list can be filtered by `category` and searched by `search` (case-insensitive, matched against `title` and `description`).

200.description: A page of recipes together with the pagination metadata.

get.description: Returns the recipe with the given id. The endpoint is public.

200.description: The requested recipe.

get.summary: List the recipes of the authenticated user
get.description: Same contract as `GET /api/recipes`, but restricted to the recipes owned by the authenticated user.

200.description: A page of the recipes owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a recipe owned by the authenticated user. The `owner` field is taken from the session and cannot be set by the client.

get.summary: Get one of the recipes of the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the recipe with the given id. The endpoint is protected by the session middleware that is mounted on the whole `/api/me/recipes` prefix.

200.description: The requested recipe.

patch.summary: Update a recipe of the authenticated user
patch.description: Partially updates a recipe. Only recipes owned by the authenticated user can be updated. The body must contain at least one field.

200.description: The updated recipe.

patch.summary: Upload the image of a recipe
patch.description: Uploads a single image for the recipe, stores it in Cloudinary (folder `yumio-app/recipes`, 500x500 crop) and writes the resulting URL to the `thumb` field. The previous image is overwritten.

recipe.description: Image file. Allowed MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/jpg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`. Maximum size 2 MB.

200.description: The recipe with the updated `thumb` field.

400.description: No file was sent, or the `recipeId` path parameter failed validation.

delete.summary: Delete a recipe of the authenticated user
delete.description: Deletes the recipe and removes it from the favourites of every user that had it bookmarked. Only the owner can delete the recipe.

200.description: The deleted recipe document.

get.summary: List the favourite recipes of the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the favourite recipes of the authenticated user. The references are populated, so the full recipe documents are returned instead of the ids.

200.description: The list of favourite recipes.

post.summary: Add a recipe to the favourites
post.description: Adds the recipe to the favourites of the authenticated user. Adding a recipe that is already a favourite does not create a duplicate.

200.description: The recipe has been added to the favourites.

delete.summary: Remove a recipe from the favourites
delete.description: Removes the recipe from the favourites of the authenticated user. The operation is idempotent: removing a recipe that is not a favourite is not an error.

200.description: The recipe has been removed from the favourites.

get.description: Interactive documentation of the API. The raw OpenAPI document is available at `GET /api-docs.json`.

200.description: The Swagger UI page.

get.description: The OpenAPI 3.0 description of this API. The `category` and `area` enums are refreshed from the database on every request.

200.description: The OpenAPI document.

sessionCookie.name: sessionId
sessionCookie.description: Id of the session stored in the database. Set by `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/login` and `/api/auth/refresh`.

accessTokenCookie.name: accessToken
accessTokenCookie.description: Access token of the session. Valid for 15 minutes after it has been issued.

refreshTokenCookie.name: refreshToken
refreshTokenCookie.description: Refresh token of the session. Valid for 24 hours after it has been issued. Used only by `POST /api/auth/refresh`.

RecipeId.name: recipeId
RecipeId.description: Id of the recipe. Validated with the `isValidObjectId` check of Mongoose, so it has to be a 24 character hexadecimal string.

FavoriteRecipeId.name: recipeId
FavoriteRecipeId.description: Id of the recipe. The favourites endpoints are not covered by a celebrate schema, but the id is still used as a MongoDB ObjectId, so it has to be a 24 character hexadecimal string.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Number of the page to return. Falls back to `1` when it is not provided.

PerPage.name: perPage
PerPage.description: Number of recipes per page. Falls back to `10` when it is not provided.

CategoryQuery.name: category
CategoryQuery.description: Returns only the recipes of the given category. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

SearchQuery.name: search
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive search across the `title` and the `description` of the recipes. The value is trimmed and may be empty.

BadRequest.description: The request could not be processed.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed. The session cookies are missing, unknown or expired.

sessionNotFound.summary: The session does not exist anymore

userNotFound.summary: The user of the session does not exist anymore

invalidCredentials.summary: The email or the password is wrong

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

ValidationFailed.description: The request failed the Joi validation performed by celebrate.

query.message: "perPage" must be less than or equal to 20

InternalServerError.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing the request.

example.message: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

User.description: A registered user. The `password` field is removed from the payload by the `toJSON` method of the Mongoose user schema.

avatar.description: URL of the avatar. Replaced by the uploaded image once `PATCH /api/users/me/avatar` has been called.

favorites.description: Ids of the recipes bookmarked by the user.

RegisterUserRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/auth/register`. Mirrors the `registerUserSchema` Joi schema.

LoginRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/auth/login`. Mirrors the `loginUserSchema` Joi schema.

RequestResetEmailRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/auth/request-reset-email`. Mirrors the `requestResetEmailSchema` Joi schema.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/auth/reset-password`. Mirrors the `resetPasswordSchema` Joi schema.

token.description: Password reset token sent by email.

RecipeIngredientInput.description: An ingredient used in a recipe. Mirrors the `ingredients.items` Joi schema.

id.description: Id of the ingredient taken from `GET /api/ingredients`.

measure.description: Amount of the ingredient needed for the recipe.

RecipeIngredient.description: An ingredient stored inside a recipe document.

_id.description: Id of the sub-document. It is generated by Mongoose when the recipe is created.

CreateRecipeRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/me/recipes`. Mirrors the `createRecipeSchema` Joi schema.

category.description: Category of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

area.description: Cuisine of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

instructions.example: Boil the pasta for 8 minutes, then add the sauce.

UpdateRecipeRequest.description: Payload of `PATCH /api/me/recipes/update/{recipeId}`. Mirrors the `updateRecipeSchema` Joi schema: every field is optional, but the body must contain at least one property.

category.description: Category of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

area.description: Cuisine of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

Recipe.description: A recipe document stored in MongoDB.

category.description: Category of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

owner.description: Id of the user who owns the recipe.

area.description: Cuisine of the recipe. The allowed values are loaded from the database when the server starts.

thumb.description: URL of the recipe image. Absent until an image has been uploaded with `PATCH /api/me/recipes/addimage/{recipeId}`.

RecipeListResponse.description: A page of recipes together with the pagination metadata.

totalItems.description: Total number of recipes matching the filter.

_id.description: Id of the ingredient. It is a slug, not a MongoDB ObjectId.

img.description: URL of the image of the ingredient.

FavoritesResponse.description: Result of adding or removing a recipe from the favourites.

favorites.description: Ids of the recipes that are currently bookmarked by the user.

MessageResponse.description: A plain message returned by the API.

Error.description: Error returned by the error handler of the application. `http-errors` instances keep their status code and message, any other error is reported as an internal server error.

ValidationError.description: Error returned by the celebrate error handler when the Joi validation of a request segment fails.

validation.description: Validation details, keyed by the request segment that failed (`body`, `query`, `params`).
